page.overview:
Who is Cactus Creatures?

The cactus creatures first appear in "Memories of Boom Boom Mountain." The mother cactus creature declares she must be pollinated to make her babies, and Finn causes a chain of events that does so. Once the creatures are born, the Dragon uses the baby cactus creatures to scratch its itchy behind.
